meaning_en: the account's history has {have} creative(s) old enough to read how many become mature, {need} needed: no number of new creatives is given
meaning_zh: 账户历史里够老、可看多少会成熟的素材只有 {have} 条、需要 {need} 条：不给需要多少条新素材

meaning_en: {month}: {days_left} day(s) left is shorter than the time a new creative takes to become mature: new creatives cannot close the gap this month
meaning_zh: {month}：只剩 {days_left} 天，比新素材成熟所需时间短：这个月来不及用新素材补缺口

meaning_en: {month}: if nothing new enters, the performance creatives fall about {gap} conversions short of the result target
meaning_zh: {month}：没有新素材的话，效果素材离结果目标还差约 {gap} 个转化

meaning_en: no creative is in a performance state: nothing to project
meaning_zh: 没有任何素材在效果状态：无从推算
